_comment: USD per million tokens, one rate per token category. Copy to pricing.json and fill in from the providers' current pricing pages; zeros here are placeholders, not quotes. Use strings for exactness (up to 6 decimal places). Keys match by longest prefix, so 'claude-sonnet-5-5' covers dated snapshots. A category with tokens but no rate fails the import: cache writes are never priced at the input rate by default.

claude-haiku-5-5._long_context_comment: Haiku 5.5 lists a second, higher rate set for prompts over 100,000 tokens; copy it here. The export's 0-200k bucket straddles that break and is flagged (see README rule 5).
claude-haiku-5-5._service_tiers_comment: Multipliers on the whole line per service_tier value in the export. Batch is published as 50% off; priority is a premium you must look up. A tier in the export with no entry here fails the import.
